    SELECT

    GROUP BY o.merchant_id
)

    COALESCE(mo.total_gross_sales, 0.00) AS total_gross_sales,

    COALESCE(ost.total_shipping_fees, 0.00) AS total_shipping_fees

LEFT JOIN merchant_orders mo ON m.merchant_id = mo.merchant_id

tasks.name: Clickstream Sessionization with Inactivity Gaps
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH session_flags AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id
                ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
            OR LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id
                ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) IS NULL
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_new_session
    FROM user_events
),
session_groups AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id
            ORDER BY event_timestamp
        ) AS session_id
    FROM session_flags
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM session_groups
GROUP BY
    user_id,
    session_id
ORDER BY
    user_id ASC,
    session_start ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH lagged AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE 
                 OR LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_new_session
    FROM user_events
),
session_indexed AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CAST(SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS BIGINT) AS session_id
    FROM lagged
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM session_indexed
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;

    t.currency,
    t.amount,

FROM transactions AS t

tasks.name: Sequential Multi-Stage User Onboarding Conversion Funnel
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH first_view AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        MIN(event_time) AS view_time
    FROM user_journey_events
    WHERE event_name = 'view_item'
    GROUP BY user_id
),
first_cart AS (
    SELECT
        v.user_id,
        MIN(e.event_time) AS cart_time
    FROM first_view v
    JOIN user_journey_events e
        ON v.user_id = e.user_id
       AND e.event_name = 'add_to_cart'
       AND e.event_time > v.view_time
    GROUP BY v.user_id
),
first_purchase AS (
    SELECT
        c.user_id,
        MIN(e.event_time) AS purchase_time
    FROM first_cart c
    JOIN user_journey_events e
        ON c.user_id = e.user_id
       AND e.event_name = 'purchase'
       AND e.event_time > c.cart_time
    GROUP BY c.user_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(v.user_id) AS total_viewers,
    COUNT(c.user_id) AS converted_cart,
    COUNT(p.user_id) AS converted_purchase
FROM first_view v
LEFT JOIN first_cart c
    ON v.user_id = c.user_id
LEFT JOIN first_purchase p
    ON c.user_id = p.user_id;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH user_stages AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'view_item' THEN event_time END) AS view_time,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'add_to_cart' THEN event_time END) AS cart_time,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'purchase' THEN event_time END) AS purchase_time
    FROM user_journey_events
    GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS total_viewers,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL AND cart_time > view_time THEN 1 END) AS converted_cart,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL AND cart_time > view_time AND purchase_time > cart_time THEN 1 END) AS converted_purchase
FROM user_stages;
